seo.metaTitle: User-Agent & browser inspector — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Inspect any User-Agent string to identify the browser family, rendering engine, operating system, and device type. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/ua-parser-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: User-Agent & browser inspector processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/ua-parser-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does User-Agent & browser inspector upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. User-Agent & browser inspector executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/ua-parser-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate User-Agent & browser inspector?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/ua_parser.json or open /tools/ua-parser?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
